title: Manifest derivation
responsibility: Builds an active unit manifest from source facts while retaining declared contracts, responsibilities, dependencies and runtime choices.

inputs.name: deriveManifest.input
inputs.description: Unit id and kind, nonempty owned source-file facts, source-path owner map, optional predecessor ids and previous manifest. The previous manifest supplies declarations to preserve.

outputs.name: deriveManifest
outputs.description: Active manifest with sorted source paths, exported symbols, derived or preserved contract, source-based dependencies plus declared dependencies, merged predecessor lineage, runtime, scenarios, preview and budgets. This function returns data without writing the registry.
